newsitem.title: USA: Casino America has shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Casino America has shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Casino America Inc said Friday it adopted a stockholder rights plan intended to encourage a potential buyer to negotiate directly with its board of directors prior to attempting a takeover.

Under the plan, each stockholder will receive a distribution of one right for each share of the company's outstanding common stock. Each right entitles the holder to purchase one one-thousandth of a share of a new series of participating preferred stock at an initial exercise price of $12.50.
The rights, said the company, become exercisable after a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of Casino America's common stock or announces a tender or exchange offer to do so.
Under certain circumstances involving a buyer's acquisition of a 15 percent position in the company, all rights holders except the buyer will be entitled to purchase common stock at half price.
The rights distribution is described in greater detail in a letter to be mailed to company shareholders. Casino America owns and operates five riverboat and dockside casinos.
